map.MR4=≤0.01%（较基线下降 4 个对数级），DMR（深度分子学反应）常指: MR4 = <=0.01% (four log reduction from baseline), while DMR (deep molecular response) usually means MR4 or deeper (MR4.5); those maintaining MR4 or better for >=2 years with the right conditions can be assessed for TFR (treatment-free remission).

map.：BCR-ABLIS 层级：≤0.0032% MR4.5、≤0.01% MR4/: : BCR-ABLIS levels: <=0.0032% MR4.5, <=0.01% MR4/DMR, <=0.1% MMR, <=1% within the CCyR range, <=10% not reaching CCyR, >10% high risk. Time-dependent response (ELN 2020): month 3 should be <=1%, months 6 and 12 <=0.1%; failing the corresponding threshold is graded "warning" or "treatment failure".
